EMAIL_UPDATES.title: GB300 + Juicebox Inter-Rack Cabling – Now in Boost Workflow
EMAIL_UPDATES.summary: GB300/Juicebox inter-rack cabling procedures are live in Boost. Builders must complete Two-Person Verification Review (TPVR) as final step. Aims to reduce 37.1% first-pass failure rate.

EMAIL_UPDATES.title: Rack Inspection Prior to Data Hall Entry - CICO Update
EMAIL_UPDATES.summary: Mirror check eliminated from CICO process. Blue Badge ID technician now performs rack inspection in Boost receive workflow. Must validate and document in Boost before moving rack to data hall. Effective 3/6, implementation 3/20.

EMAIL_UPDATES.title: Media Shredding SLA Exceeded - ICN81
EMAIL_UPDATES.summary: 3/6 media exceeded 56-day SLA in ICN81. SSD Destruction Aging at 50% (target: 90%). Shredding event scheduled. Coordination between DCO, Security, and on-call DCOs required.

EMAIL_UPDATES.title: MGMT/Console TOR Break-Fix - Model Compatibility Update
EMAIL_UPDATES.summary: MONA team updated Console_Device_Replacement Blade Runner workflow for MGMT-TORs and Console devices. AZ4444 must be replaced with AZ4444 (Non-China) and AZ4445 for China regions. Due to limited AZ4444 supply, Ciscos/LB9s/TN48M2s/AS4610s will use AS4610 replacements. MONA-Console tested build success with AS4610s.
